capabilities: Chat with DeepSeek models and save, rename and switch conversations
Convert PDFs and images to Markdown with MinerU
Reference a local paper library and import arXiv papers
Review and apply AI edits to a local Jupyter notebook
Dictate messages and read replies aloud
extras: Desktop-only, requires Obsidian 1.12.7 or later. DeepSeek charges for model tokens and per-request Search and Fetch calls; uploaded files expire after 30 days. API keys and machine-specific paths are kept in OS secure storage outside the vault, and full data flow is documented in PRIVACY.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, no PDF-to-Markdown conversion, and no way to let a model read and edit a Jupyter notebook.

relations.evidence: Chat, file questions, web requests, and speech use DeepSeek.
Choose File to Markdown to extract a PDF or image with MinerU.
The plugin creates the notebook if absent, starts Jupyter bound to 127.0.0.1

requires.name: Jupyter environment with jupyterlab, jupyter-collaboration and ipykernel

summary: Desktop-only chat panel for DeepSeek with MinerU PDF and image to Markdown conversion, arXiv paper references, and optional Jupyter notebook collaboration.
